common_conventions.representation: Introduced nonclinical skeletal homology teaching model, source-related but not traced or a complete osteological atlas.
common_conventions.homology: One upper-arm humerus, radius/ulna forearm roles, grouped wrist, metacarpals and digital chains. Horse additionally includes scapula and a separate distal panel. No fourth meaning or prior programme artwork/views copied.
common_conventions.joint_convention: Expanded clear printed joint gaps distinguish adjacent bones. Key identifies anatomical shoulder/elbow/wrist/metacarpophalangeal/interphalangeal relationships; gap is not a fracture, dislocation or missing bone. No printed ligaments, tendons or invented bony bridge across a genuine joint.
common_conventions.grouping: A closed wrist-region aggregate denotes several carpals, not one enlarged/fused carpal. Exact individual carpal counts, articular facets, small sesamoids and complete ligament attachments are outside these three fixed overviews.
common_conventions.scale: Introduced teaching proportions and separately scaled species. Not specimen morphometrics, true interspecies size ratios, radiographs or a single three-dimensional mounted pose.
common_conventions.material: Nonhuman anatomical bone/aggregate subject roles at creation; no skin, hair, clothing or human limb-template claims. Existing nominal outline/dot/material/height rules still apply; production calibration remains provisional.
common_conventions.nominal_units: 1 SVG/viewBox unit =1mm, with physical width/height in millimetres, separate from raster proof pixels.
common_conventions.physical_limitations: Metre-scale planned layouts. Device/page fit, tactile proofreading, calibrated height/material output and learner recognition remain pending. No normal-paper fit, proved minimum size or impossibility of a smaller design is established. Downscaling invalidates the current nominal line/dot/spacing checks.
common_conventions.source_observations: Twelve genuine planning views are separate from twenty-one mandatory future current wholes per actor: twelve source rows plus nine individual profiles. Planning coverage is not candidate approval.

models.projection: Main introduced LEFT lateral teaching arrangement, proximal above/distal below, cranial page-right and caudal page-left. Separate distal DORSAL exploded metacarpal panel, not a second limb.
models.shape_roles: Broad triangular scapular bone blade tapering to glenoid; proximal humerus head/tubercles and simplified shaft/joint end; olecranon and single proximal interosseous opening in a fused/reduced forearm; cannon MCIII; successive P1/P2 and expanded terminal P3. Do not copy bovine full humerus/forearm panels.
models.fused_region: Radius and reduced ulna remain two named anatomical bones represented by one fused-region exterior with one proximal window. They are not two freely separated complete forearm bones, nor biologically renamed as one bone.
models.panel: DORSAL EXPlODED left metacarpal teaching view: dominant III with two shorter II/IV splints, medial II page-left and lateral IV page-right. Splints separated laterally for visibility although normally palmar-positioned/partly hidden from dorsal view. Do not claim this is an intact external dorsal surface or add two toes. Repeated III is the same bone in another view; use the same declared longitudinal drawing scale for main/panel MCIII.
models.omissions: Scapular cartilage and hoof keratin omitted from the bone pattern; small sesamoids, individual carpals, foramina, tendons and ligaments not exhaustively shown. Source scapula photo does not establish side; left orientation is introduced using explicitly left upper/forearm sources and anatomical cranial/caudal roles.
models.unmeasured_details: No claim of exact full lateral distal-humerus tracing: selected C photograph is proximal only; joint-end contour is an explicit generalized teaching symbol, not bovine substitution.

models.age_scope: Mature ossified teaching pattern, not an embryonic/developmental sequence; no exact age/sex claim for the Figure1 specimen.
models.projection: Introduced source-oriented LEFT forelimb based on Figure1: proximal-left/distal-right, dorsal-up, radial/thumb/falciform side below. No exact dorsal-camera or fully mounted stance claim.
models.count_authority: Direct University of Lille Talpa europaea skeletal specimen-page text BA00062b, independently from tiny native472 or inferred human counts.
models.shape_roles: Very short broad asymmetric/flared hooked humerus; substantial olecranon/curved ulna dorsally above a separate radius; broad grouped wrist and stout splayed short metacarpal/phalange chains. Thumb I shorter on lower radial side. Distinct single curved falciform beside wrist/thumb base, never a metacarpal-plus-phalanges chain.
models.omissions: Scapula/clavicle and trunk not in fixed humerus-to-hand overview. Small accessory sesamoids, distal accessory elements, individual carpal fusion details, claws/keratin and muscles omitted; falciform is highlighted, not asserted to be the sole sesamoid in a mole.
models.model_limits: Separate anatomical bone roles and joint gaps remain; no generic human/canine limb or other Talpa species substitution and no digging-performance claim.

models.age_scope: Mature non-developmental teaching pattern; exact specimen age/sex not identified from source photographs.
models.projection: Source-related teaching composite: cranial right-humerus/radius/ulna forms, with the explicitly DORSAL right hand rotated clockwise from F14 to proximal-up/distal-down. Right thumb and radial side page-right, ulna page-left; no claim of one unmodified fully articulated source specimen pose.
models.shape_roles: Long subtly bowed humerus with expanded unequal ends; radius small proximal head/broad distal wrist end; ulna pronounced proximal olecranon/notch and narrower distal end. Shorter thumb metacarpal and two phalanges, four longer three-phalange digits; central long fingers and shorter outer fingers follow F14, not human thumb proportions.
models.wrist: Grouped wrist includes the source-related centrale; no literal eight-carpal human count. Individual carpals and small thumb accessory sesamoid not separately counted or converted into a sixth ray.
models.omissions: Scapula/trunk, individual carpal facets and small sesamoids, muscles, tendons and ligaments omitted. No thumb opposition angle, grasp performance, clinical alignment or exact specimen proportions claimed.
